summary.text: Suffering Loss Is A Blessing is an immortal killer move named when Lu Wei Yin uses it.

claims.text: At the crucial moment, Lu Wei Yin strained his mind and pointed at Demon Immortal Qi Jue, shooting two yellow lights. After all life is bitter is named, the second yellow light enters Demon Immortal Qi Jue’s body. Immortal killer move suffering loss is a blessing is named. Demon Immortal Qi Jue benefits from this, his body’s injuries start to recover, and he laughs loudly in satisfaction.

After Lu Wei Yin uses both killer moves, his aura diminishes to an extreme low and he escapes using the sandstorm. From within the sandstorm he says Spectral Soul committed too many sins and caused great harm to the world. Countless Gu Immortals fell victim to Spectral Soul’s two food path killer moves, so Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created these two moves, all life is bitter and suffering loss is a blessing, specially to deal with him. They were his direct counter. Spectral Soul is stuck in a passive spot at once, his two killer moves were broken. Once a killer move is broken, the user falls into a passive state. Spectral Soul’s two food path killer moves were countered by Lu Wei Yin, and he immediately suffered a backlash, his injuries severe. Lu Wei Yin kept these two moves, all life is bitter and suffering loss is a blessing, concealed as trump cards until the most crucial moment.

Lu Wei Yin used all life is bitter and suffering loss is a blessing to counter Spectral Soul, causing him to suffer an intense backlash. Fang Yuan notes that Lu Wei Yin is adept at enduring and persevering, and that he used the two killer moves, all life is bitter and suffering loss is a blessing, at the crucial moment to cause Spectral Soul a huge setback.

Lu Wei Yin and Fang Yuan drink tea in Virtue Paradise. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created the killer moves suffering loss is a blessing and all life is bitter to counter Spectral Soul’s food path methods. These two methods played a crucial role during the ambush of Spectral Soul.

Known users.text: Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable (creator) Lu Wei Yin
